title: Dong2023 – 59-subject 40-class SSVEP dataset
description: An 8-channel EEG dataset from 59 healthy adolescents (aged 10-16) performing a 40-target SSVEP-based BCI speller task. The task used joint frequency and phase modulation (JFPM) with stimulation frequencies of 8.0-15.8 Hz. Data were collected at the Suzhou Junior Competition of BCI Olympics 2022, and each participant completed 4 blocks of 40 trials.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a NeuSenW (Neuracle) amplifier using 8 semi-dry pre-gelled electrodes over the occipital region (Fp1 reference, Fp2 ground), then downsampled to 250 Hz. Each trial consisted of a 1 s cue, 4 s of flicker stimulation, and 1 s of visual feedback. Epochs span 5 s (0.5 s pre-stimulus, 4 s stimulation, 0.5 s post-stimulus).
